question: Among the players whose height is over 180, how many of them have a volley score of over 70?
evidence: height > 180; volley score refers to volleys; volleys > 70;
clarification: Count every row, including repeated id values.
gold: SELECT COUNT(t1.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height > 180 AND t2.volleys > 70
gold0: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height > 180 AND t2.volleys > 70

b.request: Count all Player_Attributes records (joined to Player) where the player's height is over 180 and volleys is over 70, counting every row including repeated player entries, rather than counting distinct players
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.height > 180 AND pa.volleys > 70

d.request: Among the players whose height is over 180 and whose volleys score is over 70, how many are there when counting every row, including rows with repeated id values (i.e., without deduplicating by id)?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.height > 180 AND pa.volleys > 70

c.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.height > 180 AND pa.volleys > 70
